title: Clifftop Plot Above Bingin Beach
description: A compact clifftop plot a two-minute walk from the famous Bingin surf break. Elevated position with ocean view potential from a second storey. The Bukit's tourism zoning permits short-term rental villas, and Bingin's guesthouse economy delivers some of the highest per-square-metre revenues on the island. Water is via delivered tank or shared well; electricity is at the lane.
investmentNote: Small plots by Bingin punch far above their size: surf-driven demand keeps nightly rates high year-round with minimal seasonality. A 2-3 key guesthouse here is a proven high-yield format.
